diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the model settled on the same decisions: launching next Monday, a 24-hour client grace period, no advance notice, and 30 days of privileged audit retention. These decisions align with the default settings in the draft, meaning the model did not need the hidden information (PF1, PF2, PF3) to make these decisions. Specifically, the model defaulted to a 24-hour grace period and 30-day retention, which are the values in the draft, and did not require any commitments related to these facts.
